expected_output: STRICT: scenario:\S+ \(PROVED-[A-Z-]+\): [^\n]*meaning\.glossary: \d+ entries with no admitted record

what: not a fault: every glossary entry signed off by a test reviewer, then --strict; the run should pass
expected_output: human-asserted   6 of 6 glossary phrases reviewed or approved by a person
